Role Overview 
 We are looking for an AI Engineer with strong BI development experience to build AI-powered capabilities and analytics solutions for a vulnerability intelligence platform.
 The role combines the development of Azure-based AI services with Power BI semantic models and dashboards, helping operational teams and executives investigate vulnerabilities, understand exposure, and track remediation progress. You will integrate AI capabilities with governed platform data, ensuring outputs are explainable, measurable, and supported by appropriate human-review workflows.
 Key Responsibilities 
Develop AI services for semantic matching, entity resolution, ownership recommendations, explainable prioritisation, and natural-language investigation.
Build and integrate LLM-based applications using Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, embeddings, semantic search, and structured outputs.
Implement confidence thresholds, evaluation datasets, and human-review workflows to support reliable AI-assisted decisions.
Evaluate correlation accuracy, groundedness, and scoring consistency, and manage prompt and model versioning.
Develop Power BI semantic models and dashboards for operational and executive reporting.
Translate vulnerability data into consistent measures covering exposure, ownership, backlog ageing, SLA compliance, and remediation progress.
Gather reporting requirements, validate business metrics, and ensure reports reconcile with underlying platform data.
Optimise report performance and enforce appropriate data access restrictions, including row-level security.
Present complex data and AI-generated insights clearly to technical and business audiences.
 Required Experience 
Strong Python development skills and practical experience delivering LLM-based applications on Azure.
Hands-on experience with embeddings, retrieval, semantic search, structured outputs, and model-quality evaluation.
Experience integrating AI services with governed data sources using SQL.
Ability to implement evaluation frameworks, confidence thresholds, explainability, and human-review mechanisms.
Strong Power BI development experience, including DAX, data preparation, dimensional modelling, and row-level security.
Experience gathering reporting requirements, validating metrics, and optimising dashboard and semantic-model performance.
Ability to communicate complex technical concepts and analytical findings to different audiences.
Key Technology Stack: Python, Azure AI Foundry, Azure OpenAI, embeddings and semantic search, SQL, Power BI, DAX.
